summary: Certificate identifying all surviving legal heirs of a deceased person for bank account closure and PF settlements.

steps.title: Death certificate of deceased
steps.description: Obtain official death certificate and family pedigree genealogical tree.

steps.title: Affidavit of all legal heirs
steps.description: All surviving heirs (spouse, sons, daughters, mother) execute joint affidavit declaring no other heirs exist.

steps.title: Submit online SDM application
steps.description: Upload death certificate, survivor Aadhaar cards, and NOC from married daughters (if applicable).

steps.title: Local Patwari/Tehsildar verification
steps.description: Revenue officer verifies surviving heirs through statements of village Sarpanch or municipal councillor.

steps.title: Issuance of Surviving Member Certificate
steps.description: SDM issues formal Surviving Member Certificate with names and relationship of all legal heirs.
